selected_fusion_candidate.name: CALLER_BOUND_IMMUTABLE_EXECUTION_GENERATION_EFFECT_FENCE
semantic_rules: EffectAuthorization and execution presence are orthogonal capabilities; neither mints the other.
A trusted IngressExecutionLease/FrankExecutionGate capability derives an opaque execution-generation fence; raw HTTP fields do not construct it.
Reservation atomically verifies current execution generation + EffectAuthorization + optional one-shot confirmation, then persists one immutable reservation-to-generation binding.
First attempt and uncertain retry must PRESENT a transient current execution fence and atomically prove presented fence == reservation-bound fence == canonical current V15 generation.
Knowing effect_id or observing the current global epoch is never sufficient execution authority.
Immediately before provider commit, the same execution generation is rechecked while the physical one-host execution gate remains held as defense in depth.

If generation changes after an attempt may have reached a provider, old retry authority does not survive; default recovery is reconciliation. A future explicit validated recovery-transfer receipt may be researched separately rather than mutating the old binding.
Provider outcome observation/reconciliation remains admissible after generation turnover because evidence is not effect authority.
Reservation-to-execution-generation binding is birth-time immutable provenance. UPDATE/DELETE/rebind is fail-closed; successor work requires fresh authorization/reservation.

Rejected stale execution cannot durably mutate the authoritative effect state merely to log rejection; durable security telemetry, if required, comes from an independent current trusted telemetry authority.
The same semantics must exist in ClayCode and lowering/runtime; Python-only epoch checks cannot be target semantic authority.
Compatibility facade and WP04 effect-contract probes must migrate with the fenced semantic signature; ordinary unbound production start paths become unreachable/historical-only.
Authority provenance remains an independent hard gate: structurally plausible request booleans, presence, token authentication or GWT salience do not mint EffectAuthorization/Capability.
